## APIs FE Phải Gọi

| API | Method | Khi nào gọi |
|---|---|---|
| `/api/v1/auth/register` | POST | User submit registration form |
| `/api/v1/auth/login` | POST | User submit login form |
| `/api/v1/auth/logout` | POST | User click logout |
| `/api/v1/auth/refresh` | POST | Access token sắp hết hạn |
| `/api/v1/auth/google` | GET (redirect) | User click "Continue with Google" |
| `/api/v1/auth/password-reset/request` | POST | User submit "Forgot Password" form |
| `/api/v1/auth/password-reset/confirm` | POST | User submit new password form |

---

## Request Format

### Login Request
```javascript
fetch('/api/v1/auth/login', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    email: formData.email,
    password: formData.password,
    remember_me: formData.rememberMe  // boolean
  }),
  credentials: 'include'  // BẮT BUỘC: để nhận httpOnly cookie
})
```

### Authenticated Request (dùng access token)
```javascript
fetch('/api/v1/some-endpoint', {
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
  },
  credentials: 'include'  // để gửi refresh token cookie khi cần
})
```

---

## Response Handling

### Login Success (200)
```javascript
const { access_token, user } = await response.json()
// 1. Lưu access_token IN-MEMORY (KHÔNG lưu localStorage/sessionStorage)
// 2. Lưu user info vào React state / Zustand store
// 3. Redirect → dashboard (hoặc intended URL trước khi redirect)
```

### Login Failure (401)
```javascript
// Show error: "Email hoặc mật khẩu không đúng."
// KHÔNG reveal thêm thông tin
```

### Rate Limit (429)
```javascript
const { retry_after_seconds } = await response.json()
// Show: "Quá nhiều lần thử. Thử lại sau X phút."
// Disable submit button trong retry_after_seconds giây
```

### Token Refresh Flow
```javascript
// Implement interceptor:
// 1. Nếu API call trả về 401 → gọi POST /api/v1/auth/refresh
// 2. Nếu refresh success → retry original request với token mới
// 3. Nếu refresh fail (401) → redirect về /login với message
```

### Google OAuth Callback Handling
```javascript
// Khi user được redirect về từ Google:
// URL có query: ?auth_status=success hoặc ?auth_status=error&code=XXXXX
// Parse URL params:
//   success → fetch user info → redirect dashboard
//   error   → show error message tương ứng
```

## Loading States

| Action | Loading Behavior |
|---|---|
| Submit login form | Disable form, show spinner trên button |
| Google OAuth redirect | Show full-page loading overlay |
| Token refresh (background) | Không show UI, silent refresh |
| Submit registration | Disable form, show spinner |
| Submit password reset | Disable form, show spinner |

---

## Validation State (Client-Side)

> Client-side validation là UX layer — không phải security layer. Server validation là nguồn sự thật.

### Registration Form
```
email:
  - Required
  - Valid email format (regex)
  - Show error on blur

password:
  - Required
  - Minimum 8 characters
  - Show strength indicator (weak/medium/strong)
  - Show/hide toggle

full_name:
  - Optional
  - Max 100 characters
```

### Login Form
```
email:
  - Required
  - Valid email format

password:
  - Required
  - Do NOT validate length (khác registration — don't reveal requirements)
```

### Password Reset Form (new password)
```
new_password:
  - Required
  - Minimum 8 characters
  - Confirm password phải khớp
```

---

## UI Expectations

### Pages/Components cần implement

1. **`/login`** — Login page
   - Email/password form
   - "Forgot password?" link → `/forgot-password`
   - "Continue with Google" button
   - "Don't have an account? Register" link

2. **`/register`** — Registration page
   - Email, password, full_name form
   - "Continue with Google" button
   - "Already have an account? Login" link

3. **`/forgot-password`** — Forgot password page
   - Email input form
   - After submit: show success message (regardless of email existence)

4. **`/reset-password?token=XXX`** — Reset password page
   - New password + confirm password form
   - On invalid/expired token: show error state (không show form)

5. **`/auth/callback`** — Google OAuth callback handler
   - Loading state while processing
   - Parse URL params, handle success/error

### Error Display Pattern
```
[Inline field error] — hiện dưới field liên quan
[Form-level error]   — hiện ở top của form, có icon
[Toast notification] — chỉ dùng cho success states
```

---

## State Management Contract

FE phải quản lý:
```
authStore:
  user: { id, email, full_name } | null
  accessToken: string | null          -- IN-MEMORY ONLY
  isAuthenticated: boolean
  isLoading: boolean

actions:
  login(email, password, rememberMe)
  loginWithGoogle()
  logout()
  refreshToken()
  register(email, password, fullName)
```

---

## Protected Route Behavior

- Routes yêu cầu auth: redirect → `/login?redirect=<original_path>`
- Sau login: redirect về `original_path` nếu có, mặc định là `/dashboard`
- Khi đang check auth (isLoading): show skeleton/spinner, không redirect ngay
